note: Fargo Park District campground in the woods of Lindenwood Park along the Red River in south Fargo, with kayak and bike rentals, grab-and-go concessions, playgrounds and riverside trails. No alcohol in the campground. --Claude
summary: Fargo Parks page + 2026 brochure read: 46 back-in sites, water + 30/50-amp, $38; showers, dump; May-October (last nights Oct 4 loop B / Oct 11 loop A); booking opens first business day of January; 14 days a month. Electric 50 newly filled. Riverview stands; LEAD: the south-row pads face the river across ~30 m of open grass bank (riverfront candidate if sites are named). Booking link changed to WebTrac (refused, unread).
flags: WATERFRONT: riverview stands; upgrade lead. On the zoom-19 tile, the south row of diagonal back-in pads (about 46.8490,-96.7805 to 46.8497,-96.7775) opens onto the river-side road. From the pad mouths to the Red River's edge is ~30 m of open grass bank with a few scattered trees. The river is ~60 m wide; no levee lies between (the park is the floodplain inside Fargo's dikes). No site map or site numbers were readable (the brochure has none, and the WebTrac site list refused), so no sites can be named. Candidate: riverfront with a caveat for the south-row sites if a site map names them; otherwise riverview as stored. The rest of the campground is under heavy woods.
